verses.text: Ha t'a junel ix ja jun niwan wejel t'a jun lugar chi', icha jun yak'nak t'a yol stiempoal winhaj Abraham. Yuj chi' ix b'atkan winhaj Isaac t'a yol yik Gerar, b'aj ayek' winhaj Abimelec sreyal heb' filisteo.
Hata' ix sch'ox sb'a Jehová t'a winh, ix yalani: Manh ach b'at t'a Egipto, kananh b'aj swal t'ayach.

Ha tiknaik, wach' ajek' t'a jun lugar tik, ayinnhej ek' het'ok, ol in ch'oxnhej in wach'k'olal t'ayach, yujto a jun lum tik ol wak' t'ayach smasanil yet' t'a masanil inhtilal, yik wach' tz'elk'och masanil tas walnakkan t'a winh a mam aj Abraham.

Manh jantakok ol wutej heb' inhtilal, icha sb'isul k'e'en k'anal t'a satcha'anh icha chi' ol aj heb'. Ol wak'an jun lu'um tik smasanil t'a heb'. Yujnhej inhtilal chi' ol scha in wach'k'olal masanil nación,
yujto a winh a mam aj Abraham chi', sk'anab'ajejnak winh tas walnak. Masanil in cheknab'il, in ley yet' in k'ayb'ub'al wak'nak t'a winh, sk'anab'ajejnak winh, xchi Jehová t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix kannhej winhaj Isaac chi' t'a Gerar chi'.

Haxo yik ix sk'anb'an heb' winh aj lugar chi' yuj ix yetb'eyum winh, ix yal winh to yanab' ix winh. Ix xiw winh yalani tato yetb'eyum ix winh, yujto ix sna' winh ta icha chi' smiljicham winh yuj heb', syik'anek' ix heb', yujto a ix Rebeca chi' te wach' yilji ix.
Hata' ix ek' tiempo yuj heb'. Ay jun k'uhal ix yilelta winh rey chi' t'a yol jun wentena to chelcheloch winhaj Isaac chi' t'a ix Rebeca ix yetb'eyum chi'.

Ix b'at chekjikot winh yuj winh rey chi', ix yalan winh t'a winh: --Toxo ix wila'' to etb'eyum ix ix tik, ¿icham chi', ma to ma'ay? ¿Tas yuj ix ala' to anab' ix? xchi winh. Ix yalan winhaj Isaac chi': --Ix in na' k'inalok tzin smilcham heb' aj chonhab' tik yuj ix, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winh rey chi': --¿Tas yuj icha chi' ix a k'ulej? Jab'xonhej maj onh ak'b'at t'a yol sk'ab' chukal. K'inalok ay junok winh ix way yet' ix, u'ujnhej am wal tz'och ko mul, xchi winh.
Yuj chi', ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a masanil chonhab': --Tato ay junok mach stzuntzan jun winh winak tik, ma ix yetb'eyum winh, ol miljokchamok, xchi winh.
T'a jun ab'il chi' ix awwi trigo winhaj Isaac t'a jun lugar chi'. Lajunhe' quintal trigo ix yik' winh t'a junjun almul inhat, yujto ix yak' wal swach'k'olal Jehová t'a yib'anh winh.
Yuj chi' manh jantakok ix aj sb'eyumal winh. Manh jantakok tas ix yik' winh.
Ix te aj nok' skalnel winh, nok' swakax winh yet' schekab' winh. Yuj wal chi' ix te chichon sk'ol heb' winh filisteo chi' t'a winh.

Ayik pitzanto winhaj Abraham smam winhaj Isaac chi', ix sjoyankan juntzanh uk'b'ila' heb' schekab' winh b'aj syuk'a' nok' smolb'etzal nok' chi'. Haxo heb' winh filisteo chi' ix b'ut'anxi juntzanh uk'b'ila' chi'.
Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Isaac chi': --Elanh t'a tik, yujto ix a te ik'ej ipok t'a kib'anh, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj Isaac chi', ix k'och kajan winh t'a sch'olanil yik Gerar. Hata' ix kajnaj winh.

Ix sjoyanxi juntzanh ha' uk'b'ila' chi' winh, ha' b'ob'ilkan yuj winh smam winh chi', haton juntzanh ha' ix smuk heb' winh filisteo ayik toxo ix cham winh smam winh chi'. Ha sb'i ha' aykanoch yuj winh smam winh chi', hanheja' ix yak'kanoch winh sb'iok ha'.
Ay jun k'uhal, a heb' winh schekab' winhaj Isaac chi', ipan sjoyan jun ha' uk'b'ila' heb' winh t'a ak'lik chi', haxo ix aji, ix ilchaj jun sjaj ha' yuj heb' winh.

Haxo juntzanhxo heb' winh tanhwum kalnel aj Gerar chi', ix yal heb' winh to yik jun ha' chi' heb' winh, yuj chi' ix yak' owal heb' winh yet' heb' winh stanhwumal skalnel winhaj Isaac chi'. Yuj chi' ix yak' sb'iej jun ha' chi' winhaj Isaac Chaklajb'ail, yujto ix schaklaj sb'a heb' winh yuj ha'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix sjoyan junxo ha' heb' winh schekab' winhaj Isaac chi'. Hanheja' ix schaklajxi sb'a heb' winh yuj ha'. Yuj chi' Ajk'olal ix sb'iejkan ha' yuj winhaj Isaac chi'.

Ichato chi' ix b'at kajnaj winhaj Isaac chi' t'a najat. Hata' ix sjoyxi junxo ha' uk'b'ila' winh, palta manhxalaj owal yuj ha', yuj chi' B'ekan ix sb'iejkan ha' yuj winh. B'ekan onh yuj Jehová yik tzonh k'ib'cha'anh t'a lum tik, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi yel winhaj Isaac chi' ta', ix k'och winh t'a Beerseba.

Ha t'a jun ak'wal chi', ix sch'ox sb'a Jehová t'a winh, ix yalani: Ha in sDiosal in winh a mam aj Abraham. Man ach xiwok, ayin och het'ok. Yujnhej to in chekab' winhaj Abraham chi', yuj chi' ol wak' in wach'k'olal t'a ib'anh, manh jantakok ol aj wik'ancha'anh sb'isul inhtilal, xchi t'a winh.
Hata' ix sb'o jun altar winhaj Isaac chi', yik syal sb'a winh t'a Jehová, haxo skajnajkan winh chi' ta'. Haxo heb' schekab' winh ix joyan junxo ha' uk'b'ila' chi'.

Ay jun k'uhal ix kot winhaj rey Abimelec t'a Gerar, ajun jun winh yamigo winh skuch Ahuzat yet'nak. Ajun pax winhaj Ficol yajal heb' soldado winh yet'nak. Ix ulek' winh lolonel yet' winhaj Isaac chi'.
Ix yalan winhaj Isaac chi' t'a heb' winh: --Ha ex tik, malaj tzin och eyu'uj, ix in he pechel t'a sat he lu'um chi', ¿tasto yuj tzul in heyila'? xchi winh t'a heb' winh.
Ix tak'wi heb' winh t'a winh: --Toxo ix kila' to ayoch Jehová het'ok, yuj chi' ix ko na' to smoj sko b'o junok ko trato het'ok. Ha jun trato ol ko b'o chi', haton jun tik:

Malajokab' b'ak'inh tzonh ixtej, yujto a onh tik, maj kak' chukal t'ayach, a tas ix aji, to xajan ach ku'uj, t'a junk'olalil ix ach ko chekeli. Skila' to aynhej swach'k'olal Jehová t'a ib'anh, xchi heb'.
Ayik ix lajwi slolon heb', ix sb'o'an jun niwan wa'el winhaj Isaac chi', ix wa heb' t'a tzalajk'olal.
Ha t'a junxo k'u, ix k'e wan heb' t'a k'inhib'alil, ix yak'lankan sti' heb' t'ay junjun. Ixlajwi chi' ix stak'lankan sb'a heb' t'a junk'olal, ix paxb'at heb' t'a slugar.
Haxo t'a jun k'u chi', ix ja heb' schekab' winhaj Isaac chi', ix ul yalan heb' t'a winh to ha t'a jun jul joyb'ilkan yuj heb' winh, ayxo ha ha' t'a yo'ol.
Yuj chi' Seba ix sb'iejkan jun ha' uk'b'ila' chi' yuj winhaj Isaac chi', yuj chi' a jun chonhab' ay chi' ta' hanheja' skuch Beerseba.
40 ab'il sk'inal winhaj Esaú ayik ix yik'lan sb'a winh yet' ix Judit, yisil winhaj Beeri hitita. Ix yik'anpax ix Basemat winh, yisil ix winhaj Elón, hitita paxi.
Ix ak'jioch skusk'olal winhaj Isaac yet' ix Rebeca yuj heb' ix chawanh chi'.
